About This System

Disclaimer: This is a personal, self-hosted system built for testing and learning purposes. It is provided as-is, with no warranty of any kind, express or implied. Whoever built or maintains this software accepts no liability for how this installation is used.
What this system does:
  • Media streaming — Jellyfin and Plex serve your video library to any device on the network (or beyond, if public access is configured).
  • Automated media management — Sonarr and Radarr track and fetch new episodes/movies, Prowlarr feeds them indexers, and FlareSolverr/Byparr get past Cloudflare-protected trackers.
  • Downloads via a VPN — qBittorrent, Sonarr, Radarr, and Prowlarr route through Gluetun's VPN tunnel with a kill-switch, and a browser (KasmVNC Chrome) is wired up as a magnet-link handler.
  • Files & photos — Nextcloud handles file sync and Immich handles phone photo backup.
  • Requests — Seerr lets anyone on the network request new movies/shows without needing direct access to Sonarr/Radarr.
  • Container management — Portainer and Tugtainer give a web UI for the Docker stack and automatic container updates.
  • Reverse proxy & public access — Caddy fronts the apps under their own hostnames; DuckDNS or a Cloudflare Tunnel can expose them outside the LAN (off by default).
  • Self-healing — a nightly routine checks container health, the VPN tunnel, storage, and package updates, fixing what it safely can and flagging the rest right here on this dashboard.
  • This dashboard — a live status/control panel for everything above.
